recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reverting to the original no-URL-parameters language would conflict with later FHIR-I decisions and examples, so no further core source work is recommended for FHIR-13448.
issue_request: FHIR-13448 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for the FHIR-core Operations page and OperationDefinition artifact. It asked whether an operation with a single FHIR resource input parameter could be invoked by POSTing that resource directly instead of wrapping it in Parameters; the accepted clarification was that this is allowed when a specific invocation has exactly one Resource input parameter represented by the request body.
initial_application: SVN revision 12843, represented in git as 5a464a090fd6700ee82d13d4bfa30a46008cca2e, applied #13448 to source/operations.html by replacing the older specific-invocation sentence with an explicit exactly-one Resource input parameter rule and a then-current no-URL-parameters limitation.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-33385 intentionally revised the same paragraph for R5 to allow POSTing the Resource input body while passing additional parameters on the URL. Applied issues FHIR-51046 and FHIR-41220 subsequently aligned the Operations page around parameters that have associated search types instead of primitive/simple-parameter wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/operations.html is active in the build through source/hierarchy.xml and currently says an operation with exactly one FHIR Resource input parameter may be invoked by POSTing that resource body, with other submitted parameters as query parameters when they have associated search types.
